text: Leave the heading empty and the bar becomes a single line. The nav then takes its accessible name from a translated default label.
note: The stylesheet draws the dividers between the links. Typed into the labels, they would be copied with the text and read out by screen readers.

links.title: Two to ten links
links.description: The description becomes the link's title attribute

links.title: No dividers below 480px
links.description: A divider at a line start marks no boundary
